residency_notes: AI21 says it operates globally and may transfer, store, and process personal data in Israel, the United States, the EEA, and other locations where it or its service providers operate. Its public policy does not specify an API execution region or a standard ZDR control; business-customer handling can instead be governed by the customer agreement and DPA.
prompt_training_notes: AI21's model terms say customer content may be used to provide, secure, and improve the service, but AI21 will not train AI21 Models on customer content unless otherwise agreed in writing.
